assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry was performed under CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
The events are intermittent arrhythmic events
The physician ordered Mobile cardiac telemetry to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The events should be correlated with symptomatic complaints of giddiness
The clinical indication is documented in the clinical indication note
The extended monitoring is required to confirm the diagnosis and guide appropriate rate or rhythm control therapy
No prior authorization was obtained before the service
The payer denial letter cites Reason Code CO-197
